no-restricted-globals.name: process
no-restricted-globals.message: Code that runs inside Claude Code has no process global. Import process from mod.js to run a program, and read the environment through engineOf(mod).claude.env.

no-restricted-globals.name: Bun
no-restricted-globals.message: Code that runs inside Claude Code has no Bun. Run a program with process.run, imported from mod.js.

no-restricted-globals.name: fetch
no-restricted-globals.message: Fetch through http.fetch, imported from mod.js, so the test kit and the mod's permissions see the call.

no-restricted-globals.name: setTimeout
no-restricted-globals.message: Wait with mod.after, so the test kit's clock drives it.

no-restricted-globals.name: setInterval
no-restricted-globals.message: Repeat with mod.every, so the test kit's clock drives it.

no-restricted-properties.message: Read the time with engineOf(mod).claude.clock.now, so the test kit's clock drives it.
